rule: A Claude worker that finishes its queue is refilled immediately. No worker waits for a wave.
idleIsPermittedOnlyWhen: the worker's environment cannot execute any assigned class of work
every claim-valid item in that class is already owned
Captain has recorded the exact hold AND a different worker owns the continuation
idleIsNotPermittedFor: waiting on an access grant when a corpus-free class of work exists. PF-B and FIX-B sat idle on a corpus grant while independent verification of the nonvisual obligations needed no corpus; that is the failure this rule exists to prevent.

refillByClass.builders: next claim-valid SOURCE_READY family that is unowned, is not a CB02 candidate, is not under a Codex candidate path, and passes the family preflight. Commit after each family.

order: 1. NJ CN 10557 appearance-stream defect: arrestOff1, dismissDt, dismissCrt, DefAddr2, DefAddr3, DefBirthDt, arrest1Dt
2. Ohio composed-family text-receipt trailing-newline binding defect
3. integrated FAIL_REPAIR_REQUIRED families not already owned
repairers.constraint: repair only the failed obligations; a repairer never verifies its own result

verifiersAndSourceWorkers: independently verify newly integrated PF output outside the Codex raster batch
process newly released source identities and exact acquisitions
hand newly source-ready families straight to the first available builder

captain.integrate: after every clean return or every 10 minutes, whichever comes first
captain.rasterBatch: dispatch whenever five new families are ready or 20 minutes have elapsed since the first new ready family
captain.invariant: one writer per overlay, build script, shared host, source receipt and canonical queue

mayWriteOnly: the CB02 verification directories on the CB02 branch
codexSidecar.resultsAre: evidence until changed-path review accepts them. Sidecar evidence promotes nothing on its own.

ownershipCollision.rule: a family Claude already claims is DEFERRED_ACTIVE_CLAUDE_OWNER for Codex, not duplicate work
ownershipCollision.why: Captain minted VF15 to PF-B and VF16 to FIX-B over ten of the twenty-five before this rule arrived. Those ten have a live Claude verification grant and Codex must defer on them. The other fifteen already hold a released verification claim from VF01-VF12, so Claude cannot mint a second grant without making them permanently AMBIGUOUS_GRANT -- which is precisely why a Codex sidecar read of those fifteen is useful rather than duplicative.
ownershipCollision.whatCodexEvidenceCannotDo: A sidecar read is not the independent read of record. It cannot make a family PASS_COMPLETE, cannot substitute for a claimed verification lane, and cannot promote anything.

ownershipUnchangedByThisRule.PF-A: every build and transferred repair lane already assigned
ownershipUnchangedByThisRule.PF-C: every build and transferred repair lane already assigned
ownershipUnchangedByThisRule.VF-SRC-A: VF13, VF17 and every current source or verification continuation
ownershipUnchangedByThisRule.VF-SRC-B: VF14 and every current source or verification continuation
ownershipUnchangedByThisRule.PF-B: VF15 — no longer held: verification needs no corpus, so its environment CAN execute this class
ownershipUnchangedByThisRule.FIX-B: VF16 — no longer held, same reason
ownershipUnchangedByThisRule.Captain: sole integrator and sole canonical claim and queue writer
